task.title: Set up bidirectional GitHub agent-control protocol

result.summary: Added the ChatGPT -> GitHub -> agent inbox on main: README (both directions, branch model, agent behavior, context rule, replay safety, security), a short docs/CODEX.md pointer, a sanitized-publish/consume inbox tool with claim/cancel, and --inbox-task-id identity + replay enforcement in the completion publisher. Published one harmless test task (github-bidirectional-transport-test-20260921, status ready, unexecuted). No application, Server, Native or infrastructure change.

tests.summary: Inbox publisher: 40 dry-run cases each asserting the specific guard (schema, unsafe safety flags, bad/traversal/absolute/missing prompt, stale timestamp, wrong repository, secrets/JWT/tokens/URLs/email, raw-export-like size/line/blob/data-URI). 3 unexpected-staged-file and 2 wrong-repo refusals. Completion publisher regression 16 + 7 cases. Sandbox lifecycle rehearsal 37/37 (fetch refusals, replay evidence, claim, identity, completion flip). Real-remote read-only gate check: executable for claude, refused for codex.

review.summary: No independent review; control-plane tooling and documentation only, no application code.

zero_write_audit.summary: No production writes and no production data access; only a read-only lookup of the active deployment record to confirm authority values.

decisions_required: No AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md exists in the repo; the pointer was added only to the existing docs/CODEX.md, and only on main. Decide whether to add root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md pointers and whether to propagate the pointer to branches agents actually work on (production and feature branches do not have it).

Confirm ChatGPT can write files to the repo through its GitHub connection; retrieval is proven, publishing a task from ChatGPT is untested. If it cannot write, an agent can publish ChatGPT's task with physiqueos-inbox publish.
unexpected_findings: Validation caught a scanner false positive: the long prompt_path tripped the base64-blob pattern and masked the intended failure of the secret-pattern tests. Fixed by masking only strictly-structured handoff paths; the harness now asserts the specific guard per case.
docs/CODEX.md is asserted by an existing unit test (mobile-first phrases); the pointer is additive (+4/-0 lines) and those assertions were rechecked.
Native Build 47 SHA f372699f is still local-only (branch not pushed).
Agents working in worktrees on other branches will not see the docs/CODEX.md pointer; the Founder's explicit instruction and the assistant's memory carry discovery for now.
backlog: Founder runs the reverse test: tell Claude to read the latest task from GitHub and execute it, then tell ChatGPT that Claude finished.
Optionally push codex/build47-native-closure so the Native SHA is retrievable.
recommended_next_step: Run the end-to-end reverse test by telling Claude: Read the latest PhysiqueOS task from GitHub and execute it.
